_about: Venue liveness check of every stay-card and cowork-card on the city pages. "removed" entries are guarded by scripts/check_venue_liveness.cjs so a regenerated page cannot bring them back. The full per-card result is not kept in the repo.
method: OpenStreetMap via Overpass (bbox around each city, name-token match, disused:/was: lifecycle tags) for 108 cities before the public Overpass servers stopped answering; Nominatim name search within ~33km for coworking and coliving cards in the other cities plus a random sample of 500 cafe and stay cards; an HTTP fetch of every venue website (status, parked-domain and closure text); operator location pages for chain coworking. No web search was available for this pass.

venues.name: The Hub by Adeva
